values.note: 23 single sites and 3 double sites in two loops: Lake (002-011) and Woods (012-027). Catalog max vehicle lengths 25-35 ft (eight sites 25, thirteen 30, two 35); sites 007, 023 and 027 list 60 ft, read as a catalog placeholder. About a dozen pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hahns-peak-lake-campground ('consists of 23 single unit campsites and 3 double sites'; no length stated) + recreation.gov catalog 231863 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Mid-June to mid-October; recreation.gov: 'may stay open after Labor Day, weather dependent' and a late opening is possible after heavy snow.

values.note: 20 sites reservable June 22 - Sept 17; 6 sites (010-012, 021, 022, 026) are first-come, and the whole campground is first-come Sept 18 to mid-October. Pay at the campground with exact cash or check (no cards).

values.note: $26 a single site; $52 a double site.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231863/rates (2026 Peak and FCFS seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, double 52) + FS page ('Single Site: $26 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Routt NF campground at ~8,500 ft beside 160-acre Hahns Peak Lake, 2 mi west of CR 129 on FR 486, in spruce/pine/fir. The Lake Loop sits on a peninsula with the lake on two sides; the Woods Loop is ~200 m west, away from the water. Lake is non-motorized/electric-motor boats only; the West Side Lake Trail follows the shore. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 26 sites (23 single + 3 double), no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water, $26 ($52 double). Max length 25->35 (catalog; FS gives none, three 60-ft sites read as placeholder). Season: FS 'Mid June - Mid October' replaces the reservation-calendar close 09-17, which moves to booking.season 06-22..09-17; fcfs some_sites. Note's 'no waterfront sites' wording dropped (contradicted). Pin within 72 m of the site centroid.
flags: Missing phone: Hahns Peak/Bears Ears Ranger District 970-870-2299 (recreation.gov facility phone; the Fishhook Fire order names the district at that number). The FS campground page only lists the supervisor's office in Laramie (307-745-2300).

Waterfront (stored lakefront; old note said 'set back from the shore, no waterfront sites') - contrary wording, re-checked: FS says the campground 'is located on the shore of a small, scenic lake'; imagery shows the Lake Loop (002-011) on a peninsula with the lake east and south, pads ~40-60 m from the water across open grass with scattered conifers (borderline for the ~50 m bound; the east-tip sites 007/008 are closest). The Woods Loop (012-027) is ~200 m from water. Lakefront left; the contrary note text was removed. Human may want a closer look at the distance bound.
Max length: FS gives none; catalog 25-35 ft with 007/023/027 at 60 ft (placeholder). Stored 25 was a note-derived figure; replaced with 35.

Status: FS page shows 'Site Closed' - ordinary end of season (mid-October). No forest order reaches it: the Fishhook Fire closure (02-06-03-26-222, through 2026-12-31) covers FSR 296.1/313.1 north of US 40, not CR 129/FR 486.
Pin 40.83949,-106.99668 is 72 m from the catalog site centroid (at the junction between the loops). OK. recreation.gov's facility point (-106.98972) is ~550 m east, out on the lake.
